FAQs
items.html:
When should I start brushing my baby’s teeth?
You can begin baby brushing even before the first tooth appears. Using a baby finger toothbrush on your infant’s gums helps remove bacteria, soothe teething discomfort, and establish healthy oral care habits early.
Is the SuperMouth Baby Finger Toothbrush safe for teething babies?
Yes! This soft silicone infant toothbrush is gentle on baby gums and designed to relieve teething discomfort. The built-in bite block also protects parents’ fingers during brushing.
How often should I brush my baby’s teeth and gums?
It’s recommended to gently brush your baby’s gums and teeth twice a day with a soft toothbrush for baby. This helps keep baby gums healthy and baby teeth clean as they begin to grow.
What age is the Tooth Keri Baby Toothbrush best for?
This toothbrush for babies is recommended for ages teething to 2 years. It’s designed to support oral hygiene from infancy through the toddler stage.
Why choose a silicone baby finger toothbrush instead of a regular baby toothbrush?
A silicone baby finger toothbrush gives parents more control, making brushing safer and gentler for infants. It massages gums, eases teething, and is softer than traditional baby toothbrushes, making it ideal for younger babies.
